# HTagInput

> Free-form tags with bulk paste, validation, deduplication and repeated form values.

[Start with the Hearth UI agent index](../../../llms.txt). This describes repository source for version 0.10.0. Match documentation to your installed source/release.

## Identity

- Vue export: `HTagInput` from `@hearth-ui/vue`.
- Custom element: `<hearth-tag-input>`.
- Constructor: `HearthTagInputElement` from `@hearth-ui/elements`.
- Category: Controls.
- [Implementation](https://github.com/samishal1998/hearth-ui/blob/main/src/components/HTagInput.vue).

## Choose and use it correctly

- Enter/comma commits a tag; comma/newline paste accepts multiple values. Trimmed exact duplicates are ignored. Backspace with an empty draft removes the last tag; IME composition is preserved. validateValue may return true, false, or an error message. Unaccepted values remain in the draft, and only committed tags submit.
- Named tags submit repeated FormData values in Vue and custom elements. Required validation needs at least one committed tag. Reset restores initial values; disabled fieldsets and readonly states are supported. maxTags defaults to 100. Use hideLabel only while providing an accessible label.
- hideLabel visually hides the label while retaining the accessible name; keep supplying label. size=compact provides dense desktop controls, with larger touch targets on coarse pointers. Without size, controls inherit theme density. --h-font-min-size supplies a 12px default floor for caption/helper text and field typography.

## Public API

label, name, placeholder, hint, error: string · modelValue, value: string[] · maxTags: number · validateValue: function · required, disabled, readonly, hideLabel: boolean · size: ControlSize

A `?` marks optional source props. Props with defaults may be omitted. Internal `formDisabled` and `control-sync` plumbing is excluded below; do not use it in application code.

```ts
type Props = {
    label: string;
    modelValue?: string[];
    value?: string[];
    name?: string;
    placeholder?: string;
    hint?: string;
    error?: string;
    required?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    readonly?: boolean;
    hideLabel?: boolean;
    size?: ControlSize;
    maxTags?: number;
    validateValue?: (value: string) => boolean | string;
};
```

### Defaults

```ts
{ value: () => [], maxTags: 100, placeholder: "Add a tag…" }
```

### Events

update:modelValue(string[]), change(string[])

```ts
type Emits = {
    "update:modelValue": [
        values: string[]
    ];
    change: [
        values: string[]
    ];
};
```

Vue-emitted custom-element events expose argument arrays in `event.detail`. Listen on the element. Native events such as `click` retain their normal payloads. The elements package provides framework-independent DOM event types.

### Slots

None

Vue uses `<template #slotName>`; custom elements use `<div slot="slotName">`. Web components do not support Vue scoped slots.

### CSS parts

base, label, frame, control, hint

Use `hearth-tag-input::part(part-name)` for an exposed part or inherited `--h-*` tokens for shared styling. Native Vue components use the shared stylesheet and `h-*` classes.

## Supporting types

```ts
export type ControlSize = "regular" | "compact";
```

## Vue example

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { HTagInput } from '@hearth-ui/vue';
import '@hearth-ui/vue/styles.css';
const tags = ref(['api.internal']);
</script>

<template>
  <HTagInput v-model="tags" label="Allowed hosts" name="hosts" required :max-tags="5" />
</template>
```

## Web-component example

Provide a mount point. For field submission, use an owning native form; the auth page already contains its own form.

```html
<form id="example"></form>
```

This is bundler-based ESM. For raw HTML, load `dist/themes.css` with a link and import `registerElements` from `./dist/elements/index.js` instead. Initial array/object properties are assigned before connection to establish reset defaults.

```js
import { registerElements } from '@hearth-ui/elements';
import '@hearth-ui/elements/themes.css';
registerElements();

const mount = document.querySelector('#example');
const element = document.createElement('hearth-tag-input');
Object.assign(element, {
  "label": "Allowed hosts",
  "name": "hosts",
  "value": [
    "api.internal"
  ],
  "required": true,
  "maxTags": 5
});

element.addEventListener('change', event => {
  const [value] = event.detail;
  // Update your application state using value.
});

mount.append(element);
```
